title: 第664章 珠中现先魂第663章 双法则真意
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
屈屠话音落下的瞬间，一股灼热的气浪从他体内炸开。
焚野法则毫无保留地铺展开来，赤色火焰顺着地面向四周蔓延，不过呼吸功夫，百里之内便成了一片火海。
几个跑得慢的探子来不及退远，被火舌卷中，连惨叫都没发出一声，便化作了飞灰。
外围观战的探子们开始仓皇后退，惊呼声此起彼伏。
“跑！快跑！！”
“这他娘的才是圣墟境真正的实力！”
火焰翻涌着冲向秦皓，却在他身前三丈处自动退开，像是被一道无形的堤坝挡住，在他身前自行分开，朝两侧涌去。
屈屠眼神微动，冷哼一声。
百里火海倒卷而回，漫山遍野的火焰开始疯狂收缩，像被无形的手收拢，尽数汇聚到他的右拳之上。
赤色火焰中，又泛起一层厚重的土黄色光晕。
“而我...领悟了两道完整的法则真意！”
屈屠的右臂上，火焰之外又浮现出第二层光芒。一层金铁般的冷硬光泽，裹着纯粹到极致的锋锐之力。
“这就是我的第二道法则，断岳法则！”
焚野法则主毁灭，断岳法则主贯穿。
一道烧尽万物，一道无坚不摧。两道法则同时凝聚于一拳之上，屈屠领悟这两条法则真意后，还从未有一个圣墟境以下的对手值得他同时动用这两道法则。
屈祁修身后，焚宇部残存的法象境和纹师们眼中爆发出狂热的崇拜。
“两道法则！大族老的焚野和断岳！那小子死定了！”
“焚野法则之下寸草不生，断岳法则之下无物不破，哪怕人榜第一又如何，在绝对的力量面前什么都不是！”
“杀了他！为大族老雪耻！为焚宇部雪耻！”
远处的废墟之上，闻人放舟歪歪斜斜地靠在白鹤背上，赵辛仰头灌了口酒，二人好似完全没有受到影响。

兰厉负手站在原地，那些朝他蔓延过来的火焰，在离他百丈外便无声无息地消失了，永远无法触及他的衣角。
“真是厉害啊。”
一直观察周围的南荣翰感叹一声，“可惜了，兰厉换来的实力，寿命怕是不长久。”
说罢一挥手，袖中飞出一片片金叶子，在周身缓缓旋转，将扑面而来的热浪尽数挡在三丈之外。
他眯着眼，饶有兴趣地看着依旧纹丝不动站在原地的秦皓。
“秦皓...让我好好瞧一瞧，你到底值不值得让我南荣氏族下注。”
威势铺垫到极致，屈屠再无半分保留。
他暴喝一声，身形腾空而起，右拳带着焚野、断岳双重法则，直直朝着秦皓砸落。
火焰翻涌如浪，山岳重压沉降，两者拧成一股螺旋状的拳劲，所过之处空气层层爆鸣，地面在拳压下轰然塌陷。
“双法同出，我看你拿什么挡！”
屈屠狂笑不止，声音里满是快意，“给我死在这里吧！”
焚宇部众人齐声欢呼，屈祁修也微微颔首。
双法圣墟的全力一击，放眼九州同阶都没几人敢硬接，秦皓一个脱凡境小辈，绝无生还可能。
content_en:
The moment Qu Tu finished speaking, a wave of hot air exploded from his body.
The Law of Burning Fields spread out without reservation, and the red flames spread along the ground in all directions. In just one breath, it turned into a sea of ​​fire within a hundred miles.
A few slow-running spies had no time to retreat and were caught in the flames. They didn't even utter a scream and were turned into ashes.
The spies watching the battle began to retreat hastily, and screams of exclamation kept coming.
"Run! Run quickly!!"
"This is the real strength of the Holy Ruins Realm!"
The flames surged towards Qin Hao, but automatically retreated three feet in front of him, as if blocked by an invisible dam. They separated in front of him and surged towards both sides.
Qu Tu's eyes moved slightly and he snorted coldly.
The hundred-mile sea of ​​fire rolled back, and the flames all over the mountains and plains began to shrink crazily, as if being gathered by invisible hands, and they all converged on his right fist.
In the red flame, there was another thick layer of earthy yellow halo.
"And I...understood the true meaning of two complete laws!"
On Qu Tu's right arm, a second layer of light appeared besides the flames. A layer of cold hard luster like gold and iron, wrapped in pure and extremely sharp power.
"This is my second law, the Law of Duanyue!"
The master of Fenye's law was destroyed, and the master of Duanyue's law penetrated.
One will burn everything, and the other will destroy everything. The two laws were condensed into one punch at the same time. After Qu Tu understood the true meaning of these two laws, there had never been an opponent below the Saint Ruins realm worthy of him using these two laws at the same time.
After Qu Qixiu's cultivation, the remaining Dharma Image Realm of Fenyu Department and the eyes of tattoo masters burst out with fanatical worship.
"Two laws! Fen Ye and Duan Yue, the elders of the rich clan! That kid is dead!"
"Under the Fenye Law, not a blade of grass can grow, and under the Duanyue Law, nothing can be destroyed. It doesn't matter even if you are number one on the list, you are nothing in the face of absolute power!"
"Kill him! Avenge the rich family! Avenge the Fenyu tribe!"
On the ruins in the distance, Wenren Fangzhou leaned crookedly on Baihe's back. Zhao Xin raised his head and took a sip of wine. The two of them seemed not to be affected at all.
Lan Li stood there with his hands behind his hands. The flames that spread towards him disappeared silently a hundred feet away from him, and could never touch the corners of his clothes.
"It's really amazing."
Nan Ronghan, who had been observing the surroundings, sighed, "It's a pity. The strength Lan Li gained in return may not last long."
After saying that, he waved his hand, and pieces of golden leaves flew out of his sleeves, slowly rotating around his body, blocking all the heat waves that hit him three feet away.
He squinted his eyes and looked at Qin Hao, who was still standing motionless, with interest.
"Qin Hao...let me take a closer look to see if you are worthy of my Nanrong clan's bet."
The power and power were at its peak, and Qu Tu had no reservations.
He shouted violently, rose into the air, and struck Qin Hao with his right fist carrying the dual laws of Fen Ye and Duanyue.
The flames surged like waves, and the mountains sank under the heavy pressure. The two twisted into a spiral fist, and the air exploded in layers wherever it passed, and the ground suddenly collapsed under the pressure of the fist.
"Both methods come out at the same time, let me see what you can use to block it!"
Qu Tu laughed wildly, his voice full of joy, "Just die here!"
Everyone in the Fenyu tribe cheered in unison, and Qu Qixiu also nodded slightly.
Looking at the full force attack of the Shuangfa Saint Ruins, few people at the same level in Jiuzhou dared to take it head-on. Qin Hao, a junior in the Transcendence Realm, had no chance of surviving.
